phases.respondersCaption: Write files, send messages, or publish outputs

engine.name: Name
engine.attributesHelp: Edit every nonstandard engine parameter without opening raw JSON.

run.confirmMessage: This starts the same runner used from the command line. It may call Ollama, Azure DevOps, email, or other configured engines.

notify.labelsDesktopOnly: Use the desktop runtime to load a local labels file.
notify.desktopOpenOnly: Use the desktop runtime to browse local files. Browser mode lists workspace JSON files.

tokenTrimmer.label: Token Trimmer
tokenTrimmer.help: Removes superfluous tokens from source files so they aren't sent to hosted LLMs

heatmap.label: Heat Map
heatmap.help: Builds a heat map based on the content and specific keywords to show how prevalent certain items are

deacon.collect.label: Deacon Source Collector
deacon.collect.help: Runs configured Deacon or core source adapters and passes their documents into the pipeline.

deacon.workitems.query.label: Azure DevOps Work Item Query
deacon.workitems.query.help: Runs one or more WIQL queries against Azure DevOps and emits JSON/markdown work item artifacts.

devops.workitems.active.label: Active Work Item Analysis
devops.workitems.active.help: Summarizes active and completed Azure DevOps work items by assignee, area, estimates, actuals, cycle time, and overruns.

devops.workitems.new.label: New Work Item Analysis
devops.workitems.new.help: Summarizes new or backlog work items by area, priority, estimate size, assignee, and planning relevance.

devops.review-items.label: Review Items by Assignee
devops.review-items.help: Builds a people-focused review of active work and suggested new work, using workload, capacity, priority, effort, and area fit.

devops.pipeline.log-failures.label: Pipeline Log Failure Extractor
devops.pipeline.log-failures.help: Parses pipeline logs and extracts failed tests, Cypress signals, spec files, and high-value failure lines.

devops.pipeline.failures.label: Pipeline Failure PR Correlation
devops.pipeline.failures.help: Correlates recent pipeline failures with pull requests completed shortly before each failure for investigation.

devops.pr.summary.label: Pull Request Summary
devops.pr.summary.help: Creates a markdown summary of pull requests and files touched by more than one PR in the analysis window.

devops.planning.label: DevOps Planning Synthesis
devops.planning.help: Combines work item summaries, planning notes, prior context, and metrics into a forward-looking planning synthesis.

devops.recommendation.label: Iteration Recommendation Analyzer
devops.recommendation.help: Analyzes iteration metrics and work item summaries to identify delivery, utilization, testing, and area-path recommendations.

extract-blocks.label: Extract Blocks
extract-blocks.help: Extracts marked sections from matching artifact entries before later pipeline steps run.

ollama.label: Ollama
ollama.help: Sends selected pipeline content to a local Ollama model and stores the response.

chatgpt.label: ChatGPT
chatgpt.help: Sends selected pipeline content to ChatGPT and stores the response.

bootstrapCollector.label: Bootstrap Project Collector
bootstrapCollector.help: Creates or fills missing project scaffolding files and passes them into the pipeline.

artifact.compact.label: Artifact Compactor
artifact.compact.help: Reduces noisy JSON artifacts into smaller records for downstream LLM or scoring steps.

word-count.label: Word Count
word-count.help: Counts words and estimates pages for matching input collections.

dumpPassed.label: Dump Passed Files
dumpPassed.help: Writes a snapshot of the current passedFiles state for debugging or audit trails.

default.label: File Writer
default.help: Writes a selected output collection to a file.

email.label: Email
email.help: Sends selected pipeline output as an email, optionally constrained by schedule settings.
